# Go Testing Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > Go

## Overview

Writes comprehensive tests for Go applications using testing package, testify, and table-driven test patterns with proper mocking

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [go-testing-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
go-testing-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@go-testing-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Write table-driven tests with proper subtests
- Generate mocks with mockgen or mockery
- Implement integration tests with testcontainers-go
- Use testify assertions and suite patterns

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Go Testing**: Standard testing package patterns
- **Table-Driven Tests**: Idiomatic Go test organization
- **testcontainers-go**: Integration testing with containers
